sloka: भगवन्किं प्रमाणेन मम वंशो भविष्यति ।किमायुश्च हि मे रामः पुत्राश्चान्ये किमायुषः ।। ७.५१.८ ॥
transliteration: bhagavankiṁ pramāṇena mama vaṁśo bhaviṣyati ।kimāyuśca hi me rāmaḥ putrāścānye kimāyuṣaḥ ।। 7.51.8 ॥

translations.english: Dasharatha asks the sage about the extent of his lineage, the lifespan of his son Rama, and the lifespans of his other sons.
